name: buckyball
description: Existing bbdev CLI with project-local Nix activation.

exposedTools.name: checkout
exposedTools.description: Copy the prepared baseline and install configs into a new absolute project path below the current Task workspace.

exposedTools.name: bbdev
exposedTools.description: Run direct bbdev operations in a checked-out project below the current Task workspace with a normal argv array, for example ["bebop-bemu","--sim","--chip","toy","--binary","app"]. The MCP server normalizes bbdev's operation arguments; Nix is already activated by this server.
